subject_inclusion: all 123 structurally valid processed subjects; no amplitude-based exclusion

window.trial_edge_rule: repeat nearest one-second window within the same original 30-second trial

temporal_encoder.architecture: R1 TemporalCNN: 32-channel input stem; otherwise identical 64-channel residual blocks and 128-dimensional embedding; nine-class head
temporal_encoder.selection_metric: mean of twelve source-validation-subject balanced accuracies
temporal_encoder.normalization: per-channel mean and SD from all windows of 110 source-training subjects only

fusion.architecture: R1 mean/fixed-softmax-weights/384-to-32-to-3 gate pattern with nine-class output head
fusion.selection_metric: mean of twelve source-validation-subject balanced accuracies

multiplicity: Holm correction across exactly the two predeclared BAcc comparisons
decision_rule: Positive effect requires positive mean paired BAcc difference, more improved than worsened subjects, and Holm-adjusted two-sided p<0.05. Approximate equality means no supported paired difference, not formal equivalence. Pattern D requires a supported negative 4s-minus-1s effect. Otherwise report mixed or inconclusive without changing the four supplied qualitative branches.
